snippet.title: Untamed Kingdom - The Wait is Over!
snippet.description:
The wait is finally over.

After years of development, iteration, setbacks, and breakthroughs, Untamed Kingdom officially has a release date.

Early Access Launch: February 27, 2026

Untamed Kingdom is a hardcore animal survival experience built around realism, strategy, and respect for nature. Every decision matters, from how you hunt to how you defend yourself, conserve stamina, and survive against overwhelming odds.

This reveal marks a huge milestone for the project, and it would not be possible without the support, feedback, and patience of everyone who has followed the journey so far.

What to expect in Early Access:
• Playable animal species with unique combat styles
• Realistic hunting, stamina, injury, and survival mechanics
• Ongoing updates driven by community feedback

This is only the beginning.

Thank you for believing in the vision.

📌 Wishlist, follow, and join the community to stay updated.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2481980/Untamed_Kingdom/

Discord: https://discord.gg/M7VvQQfyRe
